events.first_report_date: First reported date of specific injury
events.injuryId: Unique injury ID for each players injury (see assumptions for new injury classification)
events.loggedInGame: Was this injury found in a game? (0 or 1)

pbp.away_coach: First and last name of the away team coach. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.away_score: Total points scored by the away team.
pbp.away_team: String abbreviation for the away team.
pbp.description: Detailed string description for the given play.
pbp.div_game: Binary indicator for if the given game was a division game.
pbp.down_num: The down for the given play.
pbp.epa: Expected points added (EPA) by the posteam for the given play.
pbp.gameId: Ten digit identifier for NFL game.
pbp.game_clock: Time at start of play provided in string format as minutes:seconds remaining in the quarter.
pbp.game_stadium: Name of the stadium the game was played in. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.goal_to_go: Binary indicator for whether or not the posteam is in a goal down situation.
pbp.home_coach: First and last name of the home team coach. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.home_score: Total points scored by the home team.
pbp.home_team: String abbreviation for the home team.
pbp.location: Either 'Home' o 'Neutral' indicating if the home team played at home or at a neutral site.
pbp.nfl_api_id: UUID of the game in the new NFL API.
pbp.playId: Numeric play id that when used with game_id and drive provides the unique identifier for a single play.
pbp.play_type: String indicating the type of play: pass (includes sacks), run (includes scrambles), punt, field_goal, kickoff, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike, no_play (timeouts and penalties), and missing for rows indicating end of play.
pbp.qtr: Quarter of the game (5 is overtime).
pbp.roof: One of 'dome', 'outdoors', 'closed', 'open' indicating indicating the roof status of the stadium the game was played in. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.season: 4 digit number indicating to which season the game belongs to.
pbp.season_type: 'REG' or 'POST' indicating if the game belongs to regular or post season.
pbp.spread_line: The closing spread line for the game. A positive number means the home team was favored by that many points, a negative number means the away team was favored by that many points. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.stadium_id: ID of the stadium the game was played in. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.start_time: Kickoff time in eastern time zone.
pbp.surface: What type of ground the game was played on. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.temp: The temperature at the stadium only for 'roof' = 'outdoors' or 'open'.(Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.total_line: The closing total line for the game. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.weather: String describing the weather including temperature, humidity and wind (direction and speed). Doesn't change during the game!
pbp.wind: The speed of the wind in miles/hour only for 'roof' = 'outdoors' or 'open'. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference)
pbp.yardline_100: Numeric distance in the number of yards from the opponent's endzone for the posteam.
pbp.ydsnet: Numeric value for total yards gained on the given drive.
pbp.ydstogo: Numeric yards in distance from either the first down marker or the endzone in goal down situations.
pbp.yrdln: String indicating the current field position for a given play.

snap_counts.st_pct: Percent of special teams snaps taken
snap_counts.st_snaps: Number of snaps on special teams
snap_counts.week: Week of game in NFL season
